title: World Liberty Financial CEO Zach Witkoff says success of stablecoin silences charge of Trump cronyism
summary_full: Zach Witkoff, CEO of Trump-linked World Liberty Financial, said conflict-of-interest concerns related to the Trump family are misplaced.
